querySql:
select 
                                      object_id,
                                      s_info_windcode,
                                      report_period,
                                      crncy_code,
                                      s_segment_itemcode,
                                      s_segment_item,
                                      s_segment_sales,
                                      s_segment_profit,
                                      s_segment_cost,
                                      is_published_value,
                                      pct_segment_sales,
                                      pct_segment_profit,
                                      pct_segment_cost,
                                      inc_segment_sales,
                                      inc_segment_profit,
                                      inc_segment_cost,
                                      gross_profit_margin,
                                      inc_profit_margin,
                                      s_info_compcode,
                                      subject_code,
                                      opdate,
                                      opmode,
                                      to_char(sysdate - 1, 'yyyymmdd') as bath_dt,
                                      cast(sysdate as timestamp) as data_ins_time,
                                      'w_asharesalessegment.json' as task_rs_id
                                from ${srcoradbname}.asharesalessegment WHERE report_period BETWEEN '${busi_month}'||'01' AND to_char(add_months(to_date('${busi_month}'||'01','yyyyMMdd'),1)-1,'yyyyMMdd')
